page.overview:
Who is Hydro-Viper?

Rumors persisted for some time that Cobra had developed surgically altered Eels to give them insulation, webbed hands & feet and the ability to resist the effects of deep sea diving. The first confirmation came when a W.H.A.L.E. was attacked in the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of north west Africa, with the Eel squad led by a Hydro-Viper. They successfully captured both the Action Force crew and a Tactical Analysis Computer System (T.A.C.S.) containing the key to many Ministry of Defence secrets. However a further crew led a rescue. In the battle the Hydro-Viper's head was crushed by a rock wielded by Lt. Falcon.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Hydro-Vipers were first released carded as part of the 1988 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: purple face mask with red mouthpiece; purple wet suit with scaled vest; red tubing, wristbands, and shoes; webbed left hand

Accessories: dark red, crested full-head helmet; thin, black scuba backpack; black harpoon gun with fancy grip and trigger guard; black lightning-bolt knife; two scaly, dark red flippers; two standard short, black hoses; black manta ray. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/88/hydroviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/88/hydroviper.shtml Filecard]
